d.ko: FIREWORKS MANIA는 가볍고 작은 규모의 폭발물 시뮬레이터 게임으로, 폭죽을 갖고 놀거나, 아름다운 불꽃놀이를 만들거나 그냥 물건들을 날려버릴 수도 있습니다.
d.en: FIREWORKS MANIA is a small casual explosive simulator game where you play around with fireworks, create beautiful firework shows or just blow stuff up.
d.zh: FIREWORKS MANIA 是一款小型休闲爆炸模拟游戏，你可以燃放各种烟花，制作美丽的烟火秀，或者只是随意引爆东西。

rv.t: 인생이 힘들때마다 피씨방가서 플레이 하는 게임.....아직 내 컴퓨터로 해본적은 없음
This is the game rainbow six siege should have been. But in all seriousness this is great, 10/10

Firework Mania is really fun, and the far-away view is a nice addition. The only thing it’s missing now is a detonate keybind, since setting fireworks off still feels a little awkward. Adding that would make the game even better. …

Sound is broken for me. There's no acoustic delay whatsoever, like at ALL. I also can't even hear any sound variation in the explosions at all. I restarted the game, tried other maps, but the same glitch is occuring.
每次过年都不让放烟花 但是在这个游戏可以尽情燃放
⭐创意工坊进游戏里就能看到，在steam库里是看不到的 🐕游戏好评，烟花的效果很棒，氛围很沉浸。 🐱希望能出多人模式，更热闹
